mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT evaluatee_id) FROM evaluator_mappings_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_grades_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n'
SELECT final_grade_code as grade_code, COUNT(*) as count FROM final_grades_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n' GROUP BY final_grade_code ORDER BY final_grade_code ASC

SELECT d.dept_name as dept_name, COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(fg.total_score), 2), 0) as avg_score FROM departments_51 d LEFT JOIN employees_51 e ON d.dept_id = e.dept_id LEFT JOIN final_grades_51 fg ON e.emp_id = fg.emp_id AND fg.period_id = #{periodId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' WHERE d.is_deleted = 'n' GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC, d.dept_name ASC

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) e.name as evaluatee_name, d.dept_name as dept_name, fg.final_grade_code as grade, ISNULL(fg.updated_at, fg.created_at) as finalized_at FROM final_grades_51 fg JOIN employees_51 e ON fg.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments_51 d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE fg.period_id = #{periodId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' ORDER BY ISNULL(fg.updated_at, fg.created_at) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(e.eval_id) = 0 THEN 'NOT_STARTED' WHEN COUNT(e.eval_id) < ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_elements_51 ee JOIN employees_51 emp ON emp.emp_id = #{empId} WHERE ee.period_id = #{periodId} AND ee.is_deleted = 'n' AND ee.element_type_code != 'MULTI_DIMENSIONAL' AND ( (emp.dept_id IS NOT NULL AND ee.dept_id = emp.dept_id) OR (ee.dept_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_elements_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND dept_id = emp.dept_id AND is_deleted = 'n' )) ) ) THEN 'IN_PROGRESS' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END FROM evaluator_mappings_51 m LEFT JOIN evaluations_51 e ON m.mapping_id = e.mapping_id AND e.is_deleted = 'n' LEFT JOIN evaluation_elements_51 ee_join ON e.element_id = ee_join.element_id AND ee_join.element_type_code != 'MULTI_DIMENSIONAL' WHERE m.period_id = #{periodId} AND m.evaluatee_id = #{empId} AND m.evaluator_id = #{empId} AND m.relation_type_code = 'SELF' AND m.is_deleted = 'n'

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN is_done = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as completed_count FROM ( SELECT m.mapping_id, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluations_51 e JOIN evaluation_elements_51 ee_sub ON e.element_id = ee_sub.element_id WHERE e.mapping_id = m.mapping_id AND e.is_deleted = 'n' AND ee_sub.element_type_code = 'MULTI_DIMENSIONAL' ) >= ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_elements_51 ee JOIN employees_51 emp ON m.evaluatee_id = emp.emp_id WHERE ee.period_id = m.period_id AND ee.is_deleted = 'n' AND ee.element_type_code = 'MULTI_DIMENSIONAL' AND ( (emp.dept_id IS NOT NULL AND ee.dept_id = emp.dept_id) OR (ee.dept_id IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM evaluation_elements_51 WHERE period_id = m.period_id AND dept_id = emp.dept_id AND is_deleted = 'n' )) ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_done FROM evaluator_mappings_51 m WHERE m.period_id = #{periodId} AND m.evaluator_id = #{empId} AND m.relation_type_code != 'SELF' AND m.is_deleted = 'n' ) t

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) ep.period_name, fg.final_grade_code as grade FROM final_grades_51 fg JOIN evaluation_periods_51 ep ON fg.period_id = ep.period_id WHERE fg.emp_id = #{empId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' AND ep.status_code IN ('COMPLETED', 'CLOSED') ORDER BY ep.period_year DESC, ep.period_id DESC
